image_description: A collection of disposable lighters arranged on a surface. The central focus is a green lighter standing upright next to an orange and silver packaged lighter. To the left are blue and black lighters, and to the right is another silver/blue lighter. In the background, there is a red and gold object that appears to be another lighter or packaging. There is visible text on the packaging and potentially on the lighters themselves, though it appears distorted.
